# ম্যাথ একাডেমি / Math Academy — Darshana, Chuadanga

> Bengali-first information about offline mathematics batches for SSC and classes 6–10 in Darshana, Chuadanga, Bangladesh. Teacher: প্রান্ত রায় (Pranto Rai), who also teaches at Darshana Ideal School. Founded 2022.

## Facts
- Academy: ম্যাথ একাডেমি (Math Academy)
- Teacher: প্রান্ত রায় (Pranto Rai) — BSc & MSc in Mathematics; ১০+ years of classroom experience
- School affiliation: দর্শনা আইডিয়াল স্কুল — https://www.darsanaidealschool.com/
- Location: Darshana, Chuadanga, Bangladesh — https://maps.app.goo.gl/UyNxwUBw3sjnmGE29
- Founded: 2022
- Phone / WhatsApp: +880 1641-045-469 — https://wa.me/8801641045469
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pranto.rai.37
- Teaching mode: offline batches; classes 6–10 and SSC; HSC is not offered
- Maximum capacity: ১৫ students per batch. The current seat count, schedule, and fee can change; confirm directly before visiting or enrolling.
- Current programme data: ১৬ classes and ৪ mock tests per month; monthly fee range ৳৫০০ – ৳১,২০০. These are data-driven values and are not a guarantee of availability.
- Method: picture → reasoning → practice; the site does not promise a particular score or exam result.
- Library: currently one temporary test PDF titled “English Dialogue Format”; its contents are not a math formula sheet.
- Contact workflow: WhatsApp is an information request only; the website does not reserve a seat or accept online payment.
